page.notYou: If this is not you, do not answer — let the office know.
page.recordedOnly: Your answer is recorded and the office is informed. No account is created and nothing is signed on your behalf.

owner.heading: Your decision is needed
owner.intro: The office proposes a professional to issue the document. The decision is yours, as the owner responsible for the property’s documents.

professional.heading: Document issuance request
professional.intro: The office, with the owner’s approval, asks you to issue the document. Tell us whether you take it on.

done.rejected: We recorded that you do not approve.
done.officeTold: The office has been informed. You can close this page.

invalid.title: This link is not recognised
invalid.body: Open the link exactly as it arrived in your email, or ask the office for a new one.

missing.title: The link is missing
missing.body: This page only opens from the link in your email.

expired.title: The link has expired
expired.body: Links are valid for 7 days. Ask the office to send it again.

used.title: You have already answered
used.body: Your answer has been recorded. To change it, contact the office.

superseded.title: This link is no longer valid
superseded.body: The request changed in the meantime (a new send, a new proposal or an answer that was recorded). If it still concerns you, you will receive a new message.

leadChanged.title: The responsible owner has changed
leadChanged.body: Another owner now holds the decision. The office will send them a new message.

server.title: Something went wrong
server.body: Nothing was recorded. Please try again shortly.

locked.title: This link is locked
locked.body: A wrong code was entered too many times. For your security the link no longer accepts an answer; the office has been told and can send you a new one.

code.heading: Access code
code.intro: For your security: {office} gave you a 6-digit code by phone. Enter it to see the request.
code.introUnnamed: For your security, the office gave you a 6-digit code by phone. Enter it to see the request.
code.label: 6-digit code
code.wrong: That code is not correct. {remaining} attempts left.
code.wrongLast: That code is not correct. 1 attempt left — after that the link locks.
code.noCode: No code? Call the office — it is never sent by email.
